scientific_integrity: The leading two-eigenvalue asymptotic is supported by an exact similarity and positive trace limit; numerical checks are supplementary, and unindexed prior coverage is possible.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 1D hard-rod lattice/well model; one rod per site, fixed well width, thermodynamic limit preceding close packing; no uniform finite-volume statement.
title: Quadratic close-packing correlation length in an anchored hard-rod crystal
